summary: Frontend regression on /the-apartments-tac.html and shared script.js. 3 targeted fixes verified: (A) Header transparency now works exactly like east-west.html — at scrollY 0 .site-header has class 'transparent'; after scrolling past hero (scrollY 1461) 'transparent' is removed and header goes solid. At scrollY 60 both pages toggle .utility-bar.hidden + .site-header.bar-hidden. Full parity with east-west confirmed. (B) .tac-plans computed backgroundColor is rgb(17,18,16) as required; previous section (.tac-specs) rgb(5,5,5) and next section (.tac-invest) rgb(5,5,5) — distinct, readable. (C) Schedule bottom alignment: at 1440 rowsBottom == imgBottom (both 3530.34375, delta 0px). Two-column grid works: 15 rows, first 2 span full width (Gross Area 190 M², Net Area 149 m²), next 13 rooms in 2 cols with distinct right-edges col1=1073.4375 col2=1344; left-edges col1=837.4375 col2=1107.98. All 15 values present and correct. Footnote .tac-plans-footnote exists BELOW .tac-plans-body, is NOT inside .tac-plans-info, contains H2 'SPACE AS THE DEFINING FEATURE' + 149 m² paragraph, spans 1248px section width. Zero horizontal overflow at 390/430/768/1024/1440/1920 (all delta=0). Mobile 390: img renders above schedule (imgTop<rowsTop), rows align-content:start, footnote grid collapses to 1 column (350px). Lightbox: [data-testid=tac-plan-expand] opens #tacPlansLightbox with class 'open', Escape closes it. Print button: 0 console errors. TAC page overall: 0 console errors. Other shared-script pages tested at 1440: east-west.html, index.html, projects.html, contact.html, construction.html, design.html — all 0 console errors, 0 horizontal overflow. Header transparent-at-top correctly applied to pages with a matching hero (index, projects, construction, east-west, tac) and solid on pages with no matched hero (contact, design). ONE issue found: at viewport 1024 the schedule extends 64.64px BELOW the plan image (rowsBottom 1438.34, imgBottom 1373.70, delta 64.64) — spec says must be within 2px at both 1440 and 1024. Root cause: at 1024 the image column becomes narrower than rows content, so image natural height (422.89px) is less than info column stretched height (487.53px); align-content:space-between only distributes when rows fit inside container but cannot shrink content below its natural height. 1440 works because image column is wide enough that image height exceeds rows natural height.

ui_bugs.issue: Schedule bottom is 64.64px BELOW plan image bottom at 1024 (rowsBottom=1438.34, imgBottom=1373.70). Spec requires <=2px delta at both 1440 AND 1024. At 1440 delta is 0 and passes. Cause: image column width shrinks with viewport → natural image height (422.89px @ 1024) becomes SHORTER than the info column content height (487.53px). Since .tac-plans-body uses align-items:stretch, the info column stretches to full body height (which is driven by rows content). Image can't grow because .tac-plans-viewport has no height match. Fix ideas: (1) apply the mobile fallback earlier (breakpoint at max-width:1100px or 1200px rather than 900px) so at 1024 the section stacks and the align-bottom constraint is dropped; OR (2) cap .tac-plans-info height to the actual image height by setting .tac-plans-body { align-items: start; } and giving .tac-plans-info a max-height tied to the image (e.g. subgrid or JS-set); OR (3) reduce vertical padding of .tac-plans-row / clamp font-size at <=1100px so rows content shrinks to fit inside a 422px column.

action_items: Fix schedule bottom alignment at viewport 1024: currently delta 64.64px (must be <=2px). Suggested: raise the mobile-stack breakpoint from 900px to ~1100px (or reduce .tac-plans-row padding/font at <=1100px) so info column height fits within the naturally shorter image column at 1024. Rebuild via python3 scripts/build_tac.py.
critical_code_review_comments: The align-bottom strategy (align-items:stretch on body + align-content:space-between on rows) is fragile because it depends on image natural height >= rows natural height. It works at 1440 but breaks between ~900px (mobile fallback kicks in) and ~1200px where the image column is narrow but layout is still two-column. Consider a subgrid or JS-driven equal-height solution.

In tac_overrides.css the .tac-plans-rows column-gap uses clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 40px) but the .tac-plans-row border-bottom is a hard 1px rgba, which draws under both columns of a grid row and may visually collide with the column gap on wider breakpoints. Consider padding-based separators instead of border-bottom on grid children in 2-col mode.

Header transparency logic in js/script.js uses a fixed selector list ('.hero, .pj-hero, .ew-hero, .cx-hero, .bb-hero, .tac-hero'). This is brittle — each new page must remember to register its hero class. Consider a common class like .site-hero on every hero root and drop the enumeration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 non-alignment spec bullets pass fully on Taç page. Header parity with east-west confirmed. Overflow zero at all breakpoints. Only remaining issue: at 1024 the schedule dangles 64.64px below the plan image (rowsBottom 1438.34 vs imgBottom 1373.70). At 1440 alignment is perfect (delta 0). Do not re-verify tabs removal, hero-no-logo, ARCHITECTURE section, parking/arrival, map, form — all still work; only re-test the 1024 alignment after fix.
rca of the issue: At viewport 1024, .tac-plans-body grid has cols 517.67px / 383.47px. Plan image natural aspect fits 517.67px width into 422.89px height. .tac-plans-info column has align-items:stretch so it stretches to body height, but body height is driven by info's natural content (rows + gaps ≈ 487.53px). Rows use align-content:space-between which only adds space between rows to fill a container LARGER than their content; here the container equals content, so rows keep their natural height (~404px). Result: info column bottom (1438.34) > image bottom (1373.70) by 64.64px. The @media(max-width:900px) mobile fallback fixes it via align-content:start + stacking, but 1024 is above that threshold. Raising the fallback breakpoint to ~1100–1200px would close the gap window.
